assumptions.customer_address: Latest retained purchase, then source customer ID
assumptions.freight_median: Median collapsed order-line freight, rounded half-up
assumptions.geolocation: All source points contribute to medians; grouping is transformation, not row removal
assumptions.prior_population: All retained seller-products including zero-review products
assumptions.refund_time: Purchase time: Olist has no cancellation timestamp
assumptions.user_date_joined: Earliest source purchase for that customer/seller; earliest dataset purchase if no observed activity; Olist provides no signup date

fx.date_note: Latest ECB reference available on execution day, before the 22 October European publication

generation.algorithm: per-product SHA256 seed, random.Random, sorted template attributes
